HOW TO PLAY

Keyboard · trackpad

Xbox controller

iPad · iPhone · touch

  • Union attacks from the beach; the garrison holds the works. Each round is fought for one objective.
  • Stand inside the objective ring to take it. Enemies inside it stop the capture.
  • Every fallen soldier costs that side a ticket. Run a side out of tickets, or hold out until the clock ends, to win the round.
  • Earn merit for hits and captures, then spend it in camp between rounds. Fire support glows when it is ready.

Chapter 2 · Steel Rain

  • Barrages walk across the field and hit both sides. When the warning markers show on the ground, get clear.
  • Plant charges at the guns: stand by an intact gun and hold E, hold A or hold the PLANT button for 3 seconds. Then get clear: the fuse burns 8.
  • Garrison: hold the same button at a planted gun for 3 seconds to defuse it before it blows.

Chapter 3 · The Naval Brigade

  • The Charge has two rings: take the wreck line, then push on to the palisade gap. Each ring taken adds time.
  • When a ring is half taken, the garrison counterattacks out of the fort. Stay in the ring and fight them off.
  • Union players start with the Spencer carbine, garrison players with the target rifle. Switch weapons with Q, Y or the swap button.
  • New in camp: the Naval Cutlass (fast, deadly melee) and the Ironclad Broadside (twice the shells from your fire support).

Chapter 4 · The Land Face

  • The River Gate: chop through any 2 of the 3 marked palisade sections. Stand at one and hold E, hold A or hold the CHOP button. Each section falls at once, and the garrison counterattacks.
  • Traverse by Traverse has three gun chambers in a row. Take each one to push on to the next as night falls.
  • New in camp: Pioneer Axes (chop faster) or the garrison's Rally Drum (bigger counterattacks), and Sharpshooters, marksmen with long-range rifles in your squad.
